title: OISD: On-Policy Internal Self-Distillation of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.29089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent reinforcement learning (RL) post-training approaches primarily optimize the final output policy using sparse outcome-level rewards, while largely overlooking predictive signals encoded in intermediate representations. In this paper, we introduce a new paradigm called on-policy internal self-distillation and propose the OISD framework, which improves reasoning by transferring on-policy predictive signals from the final layer to intermediate representations. During rollout and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimization, the final layer acts as both the policy and a detached internal teacher for selected intermediate layers, which are guided to align with it through two complementary mechanisms: logit alignment, which transfers high-level reasoning behaviors (how to think), and attention alignment, which enforces consistent attention patterns (where to look) from the final layer to the selected intermediate laye

translated_title: OISD：语言模型的在策略内部自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 近期的强化学习（RL）后训练方法主要使用稀疏的结果级奖励来优化最终输出策略，而在很大程度上忽视了编码在中间表示中的预测信号。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“在策略内部自蒸馏”的新范式，并提出了OISD框架，该框架通过将在策略预测信号从最后一层传递到中间表示来改进推理能力。在rollout和组相对策略优化（GRPO）过程中，最后一层既充当策略，又充当选定中间层的分离式内部教师，通过两种互补机制引导中间层与其对齐：logit对齐负责传递高级推理行为（如何思考），注意力对齐则强制从最后一层到选定中间层保持一致的注意力模式（关注哪里）。
tldr: 该论文提出OISD框架，在GRPO强化学习训练中让模型最后一层同时充当策略和分离式内部教师，通过logit对齐（如何思考）和注意力对齐（关注哪里）两种机制将在策略预测信号自蒸馏到中间层表示，从而提升语言模型的推理能力。
